narrative.overview: A dark editor workspace made human: technically precise, quietly warm, and grounded in real operational software. Editor anatomy provides orientation while bold Poppins statements keep Vincent's judgment in the foreground. Hairline rules, syntax accents, an authored arrow system, and a functioning command palette form one continuous, accessible world.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy canvas with warm white ink and restrained syntax color.
Poppins for human statements; JetBrains Mono for operational detail and controls.
Ruled, edge-to-edge surfaces instead of generic floating cards.
Authored line-arrow SVGs for direction and destination.
Keyboard-first interaction with complete reduced-motion parity.

rules.name: The Syntax Rationing Rule
rules.body: Bright color is semantic, never atmospheric decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Poppins speaks for the person; JetBrains Mono speaks for the workspace.

rules.name: The Ruled-Surface Rule
rules.body: Persistent content stays on the shared editor plane and is separated with lines or tone.

dos: Do preserve exact palette values and the Poppins/JetBrains Mono role split.
Do keep the command palette keyboard-complete and restore trigger focus on close.
Do use the authored arrow SVG consistently.
Do retain full static clarity under reduced-motion preferences.
Do compress the editor into one readable flow at 900px without dropping content.
donts: Don't add decorative stock imagery, fake code, or gratuitous neon.
Don't replace ruled rows with a generic rounded-card grid.
Don't use syntax accents interchangeably or overuse chartreuse.
Don't introduce extra font families, icon libraries, or arrow glyphs.
Don't make motion the only carrier of hierarchy, state, or visibility.
